description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh:
查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

>合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.

> Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.
The domain name or IP address to which the API operation belongs.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
> 合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.
> Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid.

description.zh:
统计的维度。取值：

- **matchedHost**（默认）：表示域名维度的统计。

- **apiFormat**：表示API维度的统计。

> **apiFormat** 维度统计，需要指定对应的域名入参**MatchedHost**。
description.en:
The dimension for statistics. Valid values:

- **matchedHost** (default): statistics by domain name.

- **apiFormat**: statistics by API operation.

> When the **apiFormat** dimension is used, specify the corresponding domain name in the **MatchedHost** parameter.

title.zh: 查询个人信息涉及站点及接口统计
title.en: Query statistics on sites and API operations that involve personal information

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-api-statistic --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --matched-host a.000.com --start-time 1672502400 --end-time 1725966000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id 269 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --type matchedHost --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeSensitiveApiStatistic --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --Type matchedHost --EndTime 1725966000 --PageSize 10 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --MatchedHost 'a.000.com' --PageNumber 1 --ClusterId 269 --StartTime 1672502400 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
